description: Update app code to use explicit FK hints in Supabase select queries and remove fallback logic
steps: In src/app/employees/page.tsx: Change .select("*, sectors(name)") to .select("*, sectors!sector_id(name)"). Remove the entire fallback block (the if(error) block that does a second query without joins). Keep the error handling but simplify to just set the error state.

In src/app/employees/[id]/page.tsx: Change .select("*, sectors(name), locations(name)") to .select("*, sectors!sector_id(name), locations!location_id(name)"). Remove the fallback block that does a second query without joins.

In src/app/dashboard/page.tsx: Change the year_calendar select from .select("id, date, employee_id, employees(first_name, last_name), absence_codes(code, label)") to .select("id, date, employee_id, employees!employee_id(first_name, last_name), absence_codes!absence_code_id(code, label)"). Keep the field 'date' in the select (already there as 'date' which maps to absence_date column or date column - verify the schema: year_calendar has absence_date not date, so check if there is an alias or if the code uses wrong column name). The year_calendar table has 'absence_date' not 'date'. The dashboard code references 'date' - need to fix to 'absence_date' and update the interface and template accordingly.
Run npm run build to verify all TypeScript compiles correctly after changes
acceptance_criteria: src/app/employees/page.tsx uses sectors!sector_id in select and has no fallback query
src/app/employees/[id]/page.tsx uses sectors!sector_id and locations!location_id in select and has no fallback query
src/app/dashboard/page.tsx uses employees!employee_id and absence_codes!absence_code_id in select
The dashboard page correctly references absence_date (the actual column) instead of date
npm run build passes without errors
verification: Run npm run build and confirm exit code 0 with no TypeScript errors
findings: All changes applied successfully. bun run build passes with exit code 0. Used bun instead of npm as npm is not available in this environment. The FEAT-001.json was already modified in the working tree (not staged by this commit).
